title: Voltas Split Air Conditioner, 1.5 Ton, 5 Star - 185INV Vectra Elegant
description: Meet the Voltas Vectra Elegant 1.5 Ton 5 Star Inverter Split Room AC crafted for smarter comfort with premium energy savings. The inverter compressor modulates speed to maintain stable temperatures with lower power consumption, supported by a 5 Star rating. With 5 Step Adjustable Mode, you can fine-tune cooling capacity based on real-time room load to reduce energy waste without compromising comfort. Turbo Cooling provides rapid pull-down when you need quick relief, while High Ambient Cooling ensures reliable performance even at 52°C during harsh summers. With the Filter Clean Indicator for easy upkeep, Vectra Elegant delivers efficient, consistent comfort every day, all season.
